newsitem.title: USA: Tee-Comm's Alphastar files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Tee-Comm's Alphastar files for Chapter 11.

text.p: The AlphaStar Television Network Inc unit of Tee-Comm Electronics Inc filed on Tuesday for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
In court papers, the company listed assets of approximately $72 million and liabilities of approximately $105 million, of which $55 million is fixed-liquidated secured debt with two holders.
AlphaStar is a direct-to-home satellite television service based in Stamford, Conn.
Among the largest unsecured creditors is a $550,000 trade claim by Turner Vision of Bluefield, W.Va..
On Thursday, Tee-Comm was reported in receivership as a result of actions by its lender, the Bank of Montreal.
Tee-Comm is a Milton, Ontario-based satellite television company.
